sources.snippet: Pinned Docker recipe for serving 0xSero/deepseek-v4-flash-0731-spark on one NVIDIA DGX Spark with Local Inference Lab's SparkInfer path. The important part is memory: the EXL3 weights are kept rank-sliced on disk and losslessly coalesced to TP1, while the 262,144-token MLA cache uses a 432-byte NVFP4 record.
